visual.description: Deep navy blue used as the primary page and section background throughout the site.
Slightly lighter navy used for card and panel surfaces like pricing cards and testimonial containers.
Mid-tone navy forming the hero section background gradient base.
Elevated surface color visible in feature cards and the privacy section feature tiles.
Vivid lime green used for the primary CTA button background and the announcement banner background.
Slightly deeper lime green variant visible in the logo icon and certain highlighted text accents.
Pure white used for primary headings and large display text across all sections.
Cool light blue-white used for body copy and descriptive paragraph text.
Desaturated blue-grey used for secondary labels, attribution text, and inactive step numbers.
Muted blue used for card borders and subtle divider lines between sections.
Medium blue used for inline hyperlinks such as the 'resources' link in body copy.
Transparent/dark navy nav background in the top-of-page state blending with the hero.
Solid deep navy nav background after scroll, matching the page background for a fixed opaque look.
White used for navigation link labels and the login text in both nav states.
Lime green CTA button in the nav bar present in both scroll states.
The lime green announcement banner at the very top of the page introducing the rebrand.
Blue progress indicator bar used in the how-it-works numbered steps section.
Red used for the RECORDING indicator dot on the mobile app UI mockup.
Bright blue circle play button overlaid on the testimonial video thumbnail.
